name: Artifact Share
description: Cross-agent binary artifact sharing. Adds the share_artifact agent tool and the /plugin/artifact-share/dl/<token> download endpoint. A share is delivered either as a direct host-local filesystem path (only when both agents provably run on the same Evonic host) or as a short-lived, single-use tokenized HTTPS download URL. Messages never carry binary data.
author: Evonic

variables.name: ENABLED
variables.label: Enabled
variables.description: Kill switch. When disabled, share_artifact and the download endpoint both fail closed.

variables.name: PUBLIC_BASE_URL
variables.label: Public Base URL
variables.description: Externally reachable origin used to build download URLs, without a trailing slash (e.g. https://agents.example.com). Falls back to the EVONIC_PUBLIC_URL environment variable, then to http://127.0.0.1:8080 when unset.

variables.name: TOKEN_TTL_SECONDS
variables.label: Token TTL (seconds)
variables.description: Lifetime of a tokenized download URL. Default and expected value is 300 seconds (5 minutes).

variables.name: MAX_MB
variables.label: Maximum share size (MB)
variables.description: Largest artifact that may be shared. Default 100 MB. Host-local direct-path shares use the same bound.

variables.name: SPOOL_DIR
variables.label: Spool directory
variables.description: Server-side directory holding opaque snapshots of shared artifacts until downloaded or expired. Defaults to <APP_ROOT>/data/spool/artifact_share.

variables.name: SPOOL_QUOTA_MB
variables.label: Spool quota (MB)
variables.description: Maximum total bytes the spool may hold before new URL shares are refused.

variables.name: ALLOWED_EXTENSIONS
variables.label: Allowed extensions
variables.description: Optional comma-separated allowlist of file extensions (e.g. .pdf,.png,.zip). Empty allows any file type.
